title: Portable Subway Telltale
subtitle: Keychain-sized ambient subway arrival indicator for Roosevelt Island

decision.question: What should the screen actually show?

rejected.why: Numbers still force the user to compute 'should I leave now?' themselves

chosen.option: Three action states: WAIT / GO NOW / ARRIVE
chosen.why: Answers the user's real question directly, readable in peripheral vision

decision.quote: The hardest design decisions were not technical — they were about how much to show.
